## Relevant Symbols
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:418` — a passing verify always ends `advance pr` + `block human:merge`.
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:427` — deploy verdict `mergeable` keeps/sets `human:merge`; `:428` conflict → `conflict`; `:429` checks ≥ MAX_FIXES → `ci`.
- `hooks/ledger-recipes.sh:10` — "`.claude/project-status.json` is a file a lane can write" — config only drafts; trust = a person's approval of what was shown.
- `hooks/ledger-recipes.sh:105` — merge-check placeholders limited to `{repo_path}`, `{base}`.
- `hooks/ledger-recipes.sh:228-230` — merge requires `mergeStateStatus` CLEAN/HAS_HOOKS and checks `pass`; BEHIND → behind (routed like conflict).
- `hooks/ledger-recipes.sh:254-258` — `merge_evidence` then stamp `.pr.merge_sha` and `advance merged`.
- `hooks/ledger-actions.sh:13` — approvals store `~/.cache/hefesto/approvals/<ledger key>/` is outside every sandbox's write set.
- `hooks/ledger-actions.sh:43` — `HEFESTO_WORKER` set → refused (pattern for person-only verbs).
- `hooks/ledger.sh:129` — effective protected set = `main`, `master`, integration, environments, declared protected; `final` = last environment.
- `hooks/ledger.sh:546-547` — verdict entries carry no head SHA.
- `hooks/ledger.sh:228` — `GATES` list (verify review quality scan mutate incident vulnerability).
- `commands/hef.orchestrate.md:151` — "Ask the person's name once per session — offer `git config user.name` first".
- `commands/hef.orchestrate.md:380-382` — "It does not merge … the one exception is the deployer lane running the granted merge command".

## Existing Patterns & Conventions
- Person-only ledger verbs carry `--reviewed-by-human --by <name>` and sit in setup's `permissions.ask` so their dialog is the signature (`hooks/hefesto-setup.sh:12`, `hooks/ledger.sh:700`).
- ledger.sh is over the file limit: new logic lives in a sourced sibling, `[ -f ] || die` guarded (`hooks/ledger-recipes.sh:4-7`).
- Helpers die naming the offending value and the expected shape (constitution 5; e.g. `ledger-recipes.sh:104`).
- Smoke parts are sourced by `tests/smoke.sh`, use named fakes (FakeGhPr) and assert on the fake's invocation log (`tests/smoke-merge.sh:28-40,79`).
- Every guard is mutation-tested (constitution 3).

## Open Questions
_None blocking._ Resolved from the code (see spec D1–D6):
- Trust of a lane-writable `merge_by: auto` → a person's grant in the approvals store, pinning branch + checks (`ledger-recipes.sh:10`, `ledger-actions.sh:13`).
- "Gates PASS" at which head → record `.pr.verified_head` at verify (`ledger.sh:546` has no head).
- Integration == final environment (no `branches` block) → not eligible (`ledger.sh:125-129`).
